literature_notes: Both ledger lines (L1, L2) describe a C-terminal FLAG tag on cdhr1a (zebrafish ortholog of human CDHR1) in a full-length, membrane-anchored construct confirmed at the cell surface by K562 aggregation assay. However, CDHR1 is a Type I single-pass transmembrane protein: the extracellular domain spans residues 20–701, the TM helix spans 702–722, and the C-terminus (residues 723–859) is intracellular. A C-terminal FLAG tag therefore resides on the cytoplasmic face and does not qualify as an extracellular surface tag site. No ledger line describes any tag on the extracellular N-terminus (after signal-peptide cleavage at residue 19/20), in any extracellular loop, or at any other extracellular position of CDHR1 or cdhr1a. The ledger provides no basis for proposing any extracellular surface tag site.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal FLAG tag on full-length cdhr1a (zebrafish ortholog); the C-terminus of CDHR1 lies in the intracellular domain (residues 723–859), so this tag is on the cytoplasmic face, not the extracellular surface.
